description: This Java class represents the system configuration entity in the Shopizer e-commerce platform. It encapsulates configuration settings stored in the database, including fields for configuration key-value pairs, auditing details, and persistence mappings.

classes.name: SystemConfiguration
classes.description: Entity class representing system configuration key-value pairs with auditing information.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit section information associated with this configuration.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section information for this configuration.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier for this configuration entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this configuration entity.
